contract: Timing drills whose red is REPORTED but does not fail the gate (#6447). Each entry carries the card tracking its fix and a one-week expiry: an expired entry un-quarantines — its red gates again, and green gets flagged for promotion back into the gate.

entries.reason: Asserts a wall-clock arm-aging boundary: sleeps 1.6s (let the arm age past the bound) then 2.5s and asserts the heartbeat fires anyway — under runner load the arm ages differently and the drill goes red.
The slow-hook drill spawns a hook whose body is a real 5s setTimeout and asserts the hook runner times it out (child timeout fails open) — a race between two real clocks under load.

Asserts the crew-runner's status SEQUENCE (crew member booting | working · kickoff | idle) through a real spawned runner turn — the ordering races real process scheduling and goes red on CI runners and loaded machines, green elsewhere. Never in the old &&-chain; the #6447 runner surfaced it.

Spawns the REAL opencode CLI and asserts its recorded argv pins --dir to the seat worktree; where opencode is absent or shaped differently (CI runner) the spawn list differs and the drill crashes on a missing argv element. Never in the old &&-chain; surfaced by the #6447 runner.
